action_items: Note: current platform pricing in DB is monthly=999, quarterly=2499, yearly=9999 — not the review's stated defaults (2997/11988). This was the pre-existing state; main agent may wish to re-align seeded defaults to match the stated spec if intended.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.py punch() uses day_start() tied to today's IST day — a punch created near IST midnight could be looked up against a day_start() that drifted after a few seconds; low risk but worth passing `now` through.

ADMS /iclock/cdata POST uses $or on check_in or check_out to dedupe repost — this will not dedupe when the same device sends an out-punch that corresponds to an earlier in-punch's check_in time. A composite (device_id, member_id, raw_ts) index would be more robust.
receipt_pdf.py uses 'Rs.' prefix instead of ₹ — Helvetica cannot render the rupee glyph, so this is the correct trade-off; just document it.
admin.py churn-export reuses admin_gyms() in-process and iterates all orgs (fine at current scale, same caveat as iter14 comment).
deps._price_plans forces monthly active=True regardless of stored value — correct, but means UI should never render a disabled toggle for monthly (current implementation does).
